title: itembank course audit report
description: One cited course audit (Phase 15B, ACTIVITY-02 and RELIABILITY-03). A read-only aggregation over four signals the caller already computed: treatment state, coverage state, quality findings, and blueprint compliance. The audit recomputes none of them, because re-deriving a signal produces a second answer that can silently disagree with the recorded one. Every coverage row names which of the three EXISTING vocabularies its state came from; this phase mints no fourth.

schema_version.description: This document's own schema version; must equal x-itembank-version.

status.description: The one status this report carries. A sibling of audit_report.schema.json rather than a rename of it: that schema's coverage_row is additionalProperties false and encodes auditor.py's syllabus-objective-to-bank-item pairing, and a course-scope row pairs an objective with a source, a treatment, a blueprint, and a named vocabulary, which is a different pairing and not a longer one (D-15B-3).

course_object_id.description: The course this audit is about.

course_fingerprint.description: The course sidecar's fingerprint when the audit was built.

tool_version.description: The tool version that produced the report.

stale.description: True when any row is stale. Derived at build time from the supplied fingerprint pairs, never stored as a verdict a later read trusts, and written as an or over the rows so the report and its rows cannot disagree. A stale report is never treated as current.

stale_inputs.description: Every stale input's object id, sorted. A stale report NAMES what went stale rather than only setting a flag: a flag tells a reader something is wrong and not what to go fix.

vocabularies_cited.description: Which of the three existing coverage vocabularies this report drew on, sorted. The audit mints no fourth vocabulary; it carries a state forward with its provenance attached.

rows.description: One row per supplied coverage row.

vocabulary.description: Which vocabulary this row's state came from. Required: a state that could plausibly have come from either graph.BINDING_STATES or auditor.coverage_report without the row saying which is a claim with no provenance, and the two genuinely share strings.

state.description: The state as recorded, copied and never recomputed. Checked for membership in the vocabulary the row names.

treatment_kind.description: Copied from the matching treatment row. Empty when the objective has no treatment.

quality_codes.description: The codes of every quality finding for this objective, copied from the supplied findings and never re-derived.

stale.description: This row's own staleness, so a report can be stale in one row and fresh in another.

counts.description: Integer counts with their denominators beside them, never divided into a proportion. No share, rate, ratio, percent, or score appears anywhere in this report: a single number would let a reader mistake a count for a mastery claim, and this report is read by exactly the people most likely to want one.
